name: From-Scratch LLM
tagline: 24M + 100M models, pretrained & SFT'd from zero in pure PyTorch
why: This project demonstrates an end-to-end understanding of language model development, from tokenizer training to model architecture, pretraining, fine-tuning, and inference. The Transformer, training loop, and BPE tokenizer were built from scratch in PyTorch, with Transformers as the only external AI library used.
what: Two small Transformer models were trained from scratch: a 24M and a 100M model. The 24M model was pretrained on about 2B tokens, while the 100M model was pretrained on about 4B tokens, with both fine-tuned on roughly 5,000 SFT samples. The models can produce coherent and somewhat relevant responses, but remain far from perfect due to their limited training scale.
disclaimer: Live demo on a personal GPU. These are models I trained from scratch, so output won't match commercial LLMs — that's the point. Inference may occasionally be slow or briefly unavailable depending on GPU load.
